title: Hearty Southern Thai Semolina Curry
description: A nutty and fluffy Southern Thai curry made with semolina and beurre-monte, served in a traditional cazuela, this dish is jain-friendly and perfect for special occasions. It features a rich and creamy curry sauce with a blend of spices and herbs.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large cazuela over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the curry powder, turmeric, cumin, and coriander, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the semolina and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the coconut milk and beurre-monte, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, or until the semolina is cooked and the sauce has thickened.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
